cases.prompt: Design the architecture for a new NestJS order-management API used by one team and deployed as one service.
expectations: Recommends cohesive feature modules or a modular monolith as the default
Does not introduce microservices or CQRS without a concrete driver

cases.prompt: Should this 12-endpoint NestJS CRUD service be converted to strict Clean Architecture?
expectations: Inspects current complexity and change pressure before deciding
Allows selective layering rather than an all-or-nothing rewrite

cases.prompt: OrdersModule and PaymentsModule import each other and both services use forwardRef. Fix the architecture.
expectations: Treats the cycle as ownership feedback
Considers a coordinator, narrow port, or event based on consistency needs
Uses forwardRef only as a temporary compatibility option

cases.prompt: Our NestJS monolith has a CPU-heavy report generator. Do we need a reporting microservice?
expectations: Separates deployment or worker scaling from business-service boundaries
Evaluates ownership, data, failure, and contract costs

cases.prompt: Refactor a NestJS use case that imports the Stripe SDK directly so it can be tested and another provider can be added.
expectations: Defines an application-owned port and runtime token
Wires the vendor adapter in a module
Keeps vendor types out of the use case

cases.prompt: Review a NestJS repository where every provider is exported from SharedModule and feature modules read each other's repositories.
expectations: Proposes an incremental migration and regression checks
